name: Scout v3
note: SKELETON (24 Oct): the Scout v3 session is building the real layout on its own branch and replaces this file; kept minimal on purpose. Drone frame per dimensions.md Coordinates (x fwd, y left, z up, CG at x 0, plate top z 22). Left out (no v3 pose yet, bottom layout open): 4S 1500 pack (70 x 32 x 33, 165 g, P) and cartridge, receiver and latch, Radxa Zero 3W, flow MTF-02P, XR2, camera (pusher-era placeholder), cage and catch wheels, frame arms. Contact pairs: each prop sits on its motor (the swept band reaches the motor top). No cage part yet, so cage first reads FAIL until the cage is drawn.
